For a second test case covering the single-end branch, the source's tests/no_bai.nf.test declares the same two BAMs plus sample_id=test3: https://github.com/nf-core/test-datasets/raw/bamtofastq/test-datasets/data/genomics/homo_sapiens/illumina/bam/test3.single_end.markduplicates.sorted.bam (SHA-1:072c537f5a850f0ae036fd0ef6906f767e9f28c1). The final workflow has no other input (a boolean 'Collate in fast mode' input existed until planemo attempt 1 and was removed).
